title: Add parentheses to override precedence
narrative: Fangore adds grouping symbols so parentheses override precedence (`(1+2)*3`, `2^(1+1)`) while earlier operator stages still pass.
implementation: Agentic Recipe catalog id `guided_coding` with `environment.local_work: project_coding` and `environment.workspace: suite`. Static mode uses offline `coding_write` stubs. Live mode (`MECHA_STORY_BACKEND=live` + `MECHA_BASE_URL`) ignores stubs and binds a real OpenAI-compat Completer into `ProjectCodingLocalWork` via `completer_as_tool_loop_complete`. Product verbs `workspace_read` / `run_python` assert on-disk `calc.py` and CLI stdout for this stage's grammar plus regressions.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `grouping.yaml` inside sequential suite `calc_cli` (ordered). Live eligibility: `environment.local_work: project_coding`. Suite harness asserts live HTTP POSTs when coding stages run under live backend.
